matches.preview: The model favours Wrexham slightly with a 40% win probability, though Birmingham's 33% and a 27% draw probability suggest this is a competitive affair. Last season's head-to-head showed Birmingham's dominance: a 2-0 win at home and a 1-1 draw away point to their superiority over this opponent. Wrexham ended last season with inconsistent form, particularly struggling in away matches, while Birmingham finished with back-to-back home victories. The total-goals prediction leans towards a lower-scoring match, with under 2.5 favoured at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測Wrexham的勝率略高於其他結果，為40%，而Birmingham的勝率為33%、平局概率為27%，表明這將是一場勢均力敵的比賽。上賽季兩隊的對陣紀錄顯示Birmingham占上風：主場2:0勝利與客場1:1平局，突出了他們相對於Wrexham的實力優勢。Wrexham上賽季表現不穩定，特別在客場比賽中表現欠佳，而Birmingham則以連續主場勝利作為賽季收尾。進球數預測傾向於低進球的比賽，少於2.5球的概率為52%。

matches.preview: Derby County are favoured at 47% ahead of Swansea City's 26% chances in this Championship encounter, with the draw at 27% keeping the match competitive. End-of-season form showed both sides inconsistent, but Derby's recent head-to-head record looks strong following successive victories including a 2-0 home win. Swansea's campaign similarly mixed wins with draws in their closing fixtures. The model leans towards a low-scoring contest, with under 2.5 goals at 54% suggesting a tight, defensive fixture typical of these close encounters.
matches.preview_zh: Derby County 在本場英冠對陣中被看好，概率為 47%，Swansea City 為 26%，而平手為 27%，使比賽保持競爭性。賽季末兩隊表現都不穩定，但 Derby 最近對陣記錄表現強勢，連勝包括一場 2:0 的主場勝利。Swansea 的賽季同樣混合了勝利和平手在最後幾場比賽中。模型傾向於低進球比賽，少於 2.5 球的概率達 54%，暗示此類接近對陣的典型特點是防守緊張。

matches.preview: Middlesbrough are favoured at 52%, though the model suggests a finely balanced contest rather than comfortable home advantage. Last season's form provides useful context: the home side demonstrated clear attacking intent through wins of 5-1 and 1-0, while West Brom showed defensive resilience via multiple goalless draws. Notably, Middlesbrough have won all five of their recent meetings against West Brom, reinforcing their edge. The total-goals market is evenly split at 50-50, suggesting no clear lean for high or low-scoring outcomes.
matches.preview_zh: Middlesbrough被看好的機率為52%，但模型指出這場比賽勢均力敵，而非主隊享有舒適的主場優勢。上季的戰績提供了有用的參考：主隊通過5-1和1-0的勝利展現出明確的進攻意圖，而West Brom則通過多場0-0平局展現出防線韌性。值得注意的是，Middlesbrough在近期五次對陣West Brom中全部取得勝利，強化了他們的優勢。進球數預測呈50-50分佈，表明對高進球或低進球結局沒有明確傾向。

matches.preview: Wolverhampton is strongly favoured at 59%, well ahead of Stoke's 17% win probability in the model's assessment. Last season illustrated the gulf: Wolverhampton drew three times but also suffered heavy defeats, whilst Stoke drew only once and lost five of their final six matches. Both sides now return to Championship level with no previous meetings on record between them. The model assesses over 2.5 goals at 54% against 46% under, suggesting a closely balanced outlook for the likely goalscoring patterns.
matches.preview_zh: Wolverhampton根據模型評估被強烈看好，獲勝概率佔59%，遠領先Stoke的17%。上賽季凸顯了兩隊的差距：Wolverhampton平3場但也遭重挫，而Stoke僅平1場、最後6場中負5場。兩隊現在回到Championship級別，兩隊之間無歷史交手記錄。模型評估進球數超過2.5球的概率為54%、進球數不超過2.5球的概率為46%，暗示進球模式的前景勢均力敵。

matches.preview: Blackburn at home holds a modest edge over Queens Park Rangers, with the model rating a Blackburn win at 45% against 28% each for the draw and a Queens Park Rangers victory. Both sides showed mixed last-season form, though the visitors finished notably worse with four consecutive defeats late on. Blackburn's head-to-head record in recent fixtures tilts their way, including a 3-1 home win in February. Overall the model suggests a tight match, leaning towards under 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Blackburn 主場對陣 Queens Park Rangers 握有小幅優勢，模型預測 Blackburn 勝 45%、平手與 Queens Park Rangers 勝各佔 28%。兩隊上季表現都不穩定，但客隊表現明顯更差，在賽季後期遭逢四連敗。Blackburn 近期交手戰績占優，包括 2 月份主場 3-1 的勝利。整體而言，模型認為這將是一場勢均力敵的比賽，傾向於進球數少於 2.5 球，機率為 54%。

matches.preview: Bristol City are favoured at 45%, though draws and a Portsmouth win are both at 27%. In recent head-to-head fixtures, Bristol City have dominated, winning three of four with a 5-0 victory most prominently, whilst Portsmouth claimed a 3-0 win in December 2024. Both teams' last recorded form comes from the end of last season, where Bristol City showed inconsistency through two wins, two draws and two defeats, while Portsmouth finished strongly with four wins from six. The model predicts under 2.5 goals at 53%.
matches.preview_zh: Bristol City的獲勝概率為45%，平局與Portsmouth勝利的概率各為27%。在近期交手中，Bristol City佔據優勢，四場中贏得三場，其中以5:0的勝利最為突出；Portsmouth則在2024年12月取得3:0的勝利。兩隊最後一次有記錄的戰績來自上賽季末期，Bristol City表現不一，取得兩勝、兩平與兩負；Portsmouth則表現強勁，六場中贏得四場。預測模型表示進球少於2.5球的概率為53%。

matches.preview: The model slightly favours Norwich at 39%, though Burnley (34%) remain competitive with the draw at 28%. Burnley's relegation from the Premier League was confirmed with season-ending defeats, though they did draw 1-1 at home against Wolves, whilst Norwich's end-of-season form was mixed with a 4-2 away win but also consecutive defeats. In head-to-head meetings, Burnley have dominated the record, winning four of their last five encounters. The match appears finely balanced, with the model suggesting slightly higher probability of over 2.5 goals at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型略微偏向Norwich（39%），不過Burnley（34%）仍保持競爭力，平手佔28%。Burnley的英超降級在賽季末失利中被確認，不過他們在主場對Wolves打成1-1平手，而Norwich的賽季末表現不穩定，有一場客場4-2勝利，但也有連敗。在直接對陣中，Burnley主導了戰績，在最近五次交手中贏得四場。這場比賽顯得勢均力敵，模型預測進球超過2.5個的概率略高，為52%。

matches.preview: The model slightly favours Sheffield United at 39%, with Cardiff City at 34% and a draw at 28% creating a finely balanced contest. Cardiff's available form, from May 2025 when they competed at a higher level, marks a return to the Championship. In five recent head-to-head meetings, Sheffield United have won all of them, including a 2-0 victory at Cardiff in April 2025. Sheffield United's current record shows three wins from six, though home defeats to Preston and Blackburn signal inconsistency. The model leans marginally toward over 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: 該模型輕微看好Sheffield United（39%），Cardiff City（34%）與平局（28%）形成實力均衡的對賽。Cardiff最近的可用戰績資料源於2025年5月，當時尚在更高級別競賽，如今標誌著其回歸英冠。在最近五次交手中，Sheffield United全數獲勝，包括2025年4月在Cardiff的2：0勝利。Sheffield United目前戰績為六場三勝，惟在主場輸給Preston與Blackburn，說明其狀態並不穩定。該模型略微傾向進球總數超過2.5，概率為54%。

matches.preview: The model slightly favours Charlton at 39%, though Preston remain solidly competitive at 32% with the draw possibility well represented at 29%. Both teams showed distinctly mixed form across their closing matches of last season, each recording two wins, two draws and two losses. Preston's April victory over Charlton suggests they can compete at this ground, while Charlton's home advantage provides modest backing for the hosts. The goals picture suggests restraint, with the model leaning toward under 2.5 at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型略微傾向Charlton（39%），但Preston依然保持穩健的競爭力（32%），平局的可能性也獲得充分代表（29%）。兩支球隊在上賽季末期的比賽表現皆不穩定，各自錄得兩場勝利、兩場平局和兩場敗績。Preston在4月對Charlton的勝利表明他們具備在該場地競爭的實力，而Charlton的主場優勢為東道主提供適度的支持。進球情況顯示趨於保守，模型傾向於少於2.5球（57%）。

matches.preview: Southampton edge the model's assessment with a 46% win probability, though this is a closely contested fixture with Millwall and draws both at 27%. Southampton's end-of-season form included four wins in their final six matches, while Millwall accumulated three victories from their last six games. In their recent head-to-head meetings, results have been mixed: Millwall secured a 3-2 victory in one recent fixture and the teams drew 0-0 in another. Goals marginally favour a higher-scoring outcome, with over 2.5 at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: Southampton 在模型評估中略佔上風，勝率達 46%，不過 Millwall 和平手的機率分別均為 27%，這場比賽旗鼓相當。Southampton 賽季末期戰績良好，最後六場贏了四場，Millwall 則在最後六場累積三場勝利。從近期交手記錄來看，結果不一，Millwall 曾以 3-2 的比分取勝，兩隊也曾 0-0 打平。就進球數而言，略傾向高比分局面，大於 2.5 球的機率為 52%。

matches.preview: West Ham are strong favourites at 57% to win, with Watford at just 19%. Watford's recent campaign ended with five defeats in six games, marking a difficult period. Historically, West Ham have won all five meetings against Watford, with four of those bringing four or more goals. The model sees scope for an open encounter, with over 2.5 goals at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: West Ham 在獲勝方面處於強勢地位，獲勝概率為57%，而 Watford 僅為19%。Watford 近期賽季以六場中五敗作結，經歷了困難時期。從歷史交手記錄來看，West Ham 在對陣 Watford 的五次比賽中全勝，其中四場進球數達四球或以上。該模型認為這場比賽可能呈現開放式對陣，進球數超過2.5球的概率為57%。
